name: Rim Atmosphere
description: Presentation only (19i): the outer rim of the galaxy looks colder, darker and lonelier — cold colour grading, procedural dark dust lanes, dark murk over unexplored rim systems, derelict hulks, eyes in the dark (small blinking red pairs) in rim systems, dimmer lights and a vignette deep in the rim. No gameplay change.
